analysis:
Integration of all 10 units. The visible changes are documentation (changelog.d/ssd-restore-without-eval-lock.md, docs/architecture/inference.md lines 3 and 252-260, docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md lines 3 and 784-791, docs/architecture/hardware-support.md, docs/developer/test.md, docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md line 119), a libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer bump (14661d9b -> c17693f5), and a new opt-in live test, provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Inference/Live/PrefixQualification/ModelCheckpointRestoreContentionLiveTests.swift (lines 1-261). The test requires DARKBLOOM_RESTORE_CONTENTION_BENCHMARK=1 and DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_EXCLUSIVE_GPU=1, and writes timing reports only to a new path. No production gating, TTL, HMAC lookup tags, DBK3 AAD or coordinator scope derivation is changed in the supplied evidence, so no finding is reported.

The documented behavior change is on the SSD restore path (T-041, TB-007, A-001, T-028). Provider-staged complete-checkpoint imports now build destinations from zeroed host buffers and skip eval and stream fences, so staging no longer waits on MLX's process-wide evalLock. The import plan charges the largest host-zero source as staging scratch, and the zero source may briefly commit memory outside the MLX allocator.

The implementing code (CheckpointHostZeros.swift, CompleteCheckpointImportPlan.swift, CompleteCheckpointTransfer.swift, PagedCheckpointStorage.swift) lives in the unreviewed submodule bump or other files not supplied. These claims are unverified; this is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety.

Points for deeper review if the submodule source is available:
1. Zero-initialized destinations must be fully overwritten with authenticated (GCM) data before any use, so no stale or zero KV leaks across tenant scopes.
2. Scratch memory must be charged to GlobalKVCacheBudget or ProcessMemoryLedger and released on failure or cancel paths.
3. Skipping eval and fences must not allow reads of partially restored state.
4. The restore-timing change should not widen the SEC-035 oracle beyond what is already accepted.

The test-only SPI (@_spi(Benchmarking)) is not shown to be reachable from production builds.
